ei.title: Movement in the Museum: Heart Centering Yoga
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Find inner strength and peace in our Movement in the Museum: Heart Centering Yoga session, where we practice the ancient art of yoga surrounded by fossils. Date and Time: Tuesday, May 19th from 5:45 pm to 6:30 pm. Location: Chesterfield Museum of Natural History. Classes: Two separate classes (beginner and intermediate) will be held at the same time — each led by a trained yoga instructor. The beginner class will include chairs for those who need them. Participation Fees: Museum Members: $5. Early Registration (Non-Members): $15. Day of Registration (Non-Members): $20. General Information: Participants must be 18 years or older and will be required to sign a participation agreement. Please bring your yoga mat and water as they are not provided. Register for the class online. Parking in the museum is free after 5:00 pm. Contact Information: If you have any questions, contact Grace Harrell (Education Outreach Coordinator, Chesterfield Museum of Natural History) by calling 305-349-6483.

questions.passage: Find inner strength and peace in our Movement in the Museum: Heart Centering Yoga session, where we practice the ancient art of yoga surrounded by fossils. Date and Time: Tuesday, May 19th from 5:45 pm to 6:30 pm. Location: Chesterfield Museum of Natural History. Classes: Two separate classes (beginner and intermediate) will be held at the same time — each led by a trained yoga instructor. The beginner class will include chairs for those who need them. Participation Fees: Museum Members: $5. Early Registration (Non-Members): $15. Day of Registration (Non-Members): $20. General Information: Participants must be 18 years or older and will be required to sign __________. Please bring your yoga mat and water as they are not provided. Register for the class online. Parking in the museum is free after 5:00 pm. Contact Information: If you have any questions, contact Grace Harrell (Education Outreach Coordinator, Chesterfield Museum of Natural History) by calling 305-349-6483.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 참가자는 18세 이상이어야 하며 참여 동의서(a participation agreement)에 서명해야 한다
det.analysis:
